name: Melissa A. Long
description: Concurred, arguing that Mr. Brown had a reasonable expectation of privacy during his conversation with his mother in the police interview room, and the police recording violated his Fourth Amendment and state constitutional rights.

name: Justice Robinson
description: Concurred that plaintiffs lacked standing but dissented from the majority's decision to address issues beyond standing.

name: Justice Lynch Prata
description: Concurred, argued that the civil death statute is unconstitutional because it completely deprives life-sentenced prisoners of their right to bring civil actions, violating Article 1, Section 5 of the Rhode Island Constitution.

name: Justice Goldberg
description: Dissented, argued that the civil death statute should be addressed prospectively by the General Assembly, not the court, and that the majority's decision will unnecessarily open floodgates to frivolous inmate claims.

name: Chief Justice Suttell
description: Concurred, arguing that the Superior Court correctly dismissed the plaintiff's claims under RICRA due to issue preclusion and that Article 1, Section 2 of the Rhode Island Constitution does not create a private cause of action.

name: Justice Long
description: Did not participate in the case.
